title: Yellowed Rich British Boudin Blanc Shepherds Pie
description: A rich and velvety British dish featuring boudin blanc, lardons, and a gluten-free friendly crust, served in a tandoor clay pot. This fatty and flavorful shepherds pie is perfect for a brunch mood.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Render the lardons in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the pan and set aside, leaving the grease in the pan.
Add the chopped onions to the pan and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the boudin blanc to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it has thickened slightly.
While the filling is cooking, prepare the crust by combining the gluten-free flour, butter, and eggs in a bowl.
Mix the crust ingredients until they form a cohesive dough.
Roll out the crust to fit the top of the tandoor clay pot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
